components.name: Editor Button
components.description: Paper button for ordinary editor actions.
components.css: .ds-editor-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 37px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--editor-line, rgba(70, 70, 58, 0.14)); border-radius: 7px; color: var(--preview-ink, #2e3835); background: #faf6ef; font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 "Roboto", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-editor-default:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #eae5d9; } .ds-editor-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #985637; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-editor-default:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-editor-default { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Primary Editor Button
components.description: Terracotta variant of the established editor button.
components.css: .ds-editor-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 37px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; color: #fff9ef; background: var(--preview-accent, #bd724d); font: 600 0.875rem/1.4 "Roboto", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-editor-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #a7603d; } .ds-editor-primary:active:not(:disabled) { background: #925235; } .ds-editor-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #985637; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-editor-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-editor-primary { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Text Editor Button
components.description: The existing terracotta text variant for subordinate editor actions.
components.css: .ds-editor-text { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 37px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; color: #85492f; background: transparent; font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 "Roboto", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-editor-text:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #eae5d9; } .ds-editor-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #985637; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-editor-text:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Connection Action
components.description: Blue inline action with an incumbent Tabler SVG icon.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-connection-add"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5l0 14"/><path d="M5 12l14 0"/></svg>Add reading</button>
components.css: .ds-connection-add { display: flex; gap: 7px; align-items: center; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #365f6c; font: 500 13px/1.5 "Roboto", sans-serif; padding: 10px 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-connection-add:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #365f6c; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-connection-add:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; }

components.name: Source Search
components.description: Search field that outlines the containing surface on focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-source-search"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 10a7 7 0 1 0 14 0a7 7 0 1 0 -14 0"/><path d="M21 21l-6 -6"/></svg><input type="search" aria-label="Search all compatible sources" placeholder="Search sensors, devices, names or IDs…"/></label>
components.css: .ds-source-search { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 0 13px; background: #eeefe8; border-radius: 8px; font: 14px/1.5 "Roboto", sans-serif; } .ds-source-search:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #365f6c; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-source-search svg { color: #58675e; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-source-search input { flex: 1; width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #2e3835; padding: 12px 0; caret-color: #365f6c; outline: none; font: inherit; } .ds-source-search input::placeholder { color: #58675e; opacity: 1; }

components.name: Mode Navigation
components.description: Labeled mode navigation with the existing Connect chrome treatment.
components.html: <nav class="ds-mode-navigation" aria-label="Editor mode"><button type="button" aria-pressed="false">Construct</button><button type="button" aria-pressed="false">Arrange</button><button type="button" aria-pressed="true">Connect</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-mode-navigation { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--editor-line, rgba(70, 70, 58, 0.14)); border-radius: 11px; background: rgba(247, 242, 233, 0.94); box-shadow: 0 5px 18px rgba(70, 60, 43, 0.05); } .ds-mode-navigation button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 37px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; color: var(--preview-muted, #6f7771); background: transparent; font: 600 0.875rem "Roboto", sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mode-navigation button:hover { background: #eae5d9; color: var(--preview-ink, #2e3835); } .ds-mode-navigation button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #426b7a; background: #dfe8e7; } .ds-mode-navigation button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #426b7a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Source Type Filters
components.description: Wrapping source filters with an explicit pressed state.
components.css: .ds-type-filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 14px 0 12px; } .ds-type-filters button { border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #efede5; color: #58675e; padding: 7px 10px; font: 12px/1.5 "Roboto", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-type-filters button:hover { background: #e3e8de; } .ds-type-filters button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: white; background: #365f6c; } .ds-type-filters button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #365f6c; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-type-filters button { transition: background 160ms ease-out; } }

components.name: Source Surface
components.description: Brighter Connect source layer with desktop overlap, scoped Connect corners and a shared directional shadow.
components.html:
Temperature

Choose a Home Assistant source for Temperature.
components.css: .ds-source-surface { position: relative; z-index: 2; display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; margin-left: -12px; padding: 20px 24px 16px; background: #fffcf6; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: -12px 8px 28px -24px rgb(35 60 49 / 42%); color: #2e3835; font: 14px/1.5 "Roboto", sans-serif; } .ds-connection-column-heading { min-height: 96px; margin: 0; } .ds-connection-column-heading h2 { margin: 0; color: #2e3835; font: 600 20px/1.3 "Roboto", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-connection-column-heading p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #58675e; font: 13px/1.5 "Roboto", sans-serif; } @media (max-width: 1100px) { .ds-source-surface { padding: 20px 18px 14px; } } @media (min-width: 761px) and (max-width: 1240px) { .ds-source-surface { margin-left: 0; } } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-source-surface { padding: 22px 16px 16px; margin-left: 0; box-shadow: none; } .ds-connection-column-heading { min-height: 0; margin-bottom: 14px; } .ds-connection-column-heading p { display: none; } }

components.name: Selected Source Row
components.description: Named source, context, reading and selection mark in one flat row; synthetic example data.
components.css: .ds-source-row { display: flex; gap: 13px; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-height: 76px; padding: 13px 10px; margin-bottom: 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; text-align: left; color: #2e3835; font: 14px/1.5 "Roboto", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-source-row:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #f0f1e9; } .ds-source-row[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #e8eee2; } .ds-source-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #365f6c; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-source-identity { display: flex; flex: 1; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-source-identity strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-source-identity > span { color: #58675e; font-size: 12px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-source-value { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font-size: 12px; color: #365f6c; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-source-value svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-source-row { transition: background 160ms ease-out; } }

components.name: Model Display Switch

components.name: Mobile Panel Navigation
components.description: Underlined Tools, Properties and Issues controls inside the shared full-screen Construct and Arrange dialog. Arrange labels Tools as Catalog.
components.css: .ds-panel-tabs { display: flex; gap: 24px; min-height: 44px; margin: 0 0 4px; padding: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--editor-line, rgba(70, 70, 58, 0.14)); background: var(--preview-paper, #f5f0e7); } .ds-panel-tabs button { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 0 10px; margin: 0 0 -1px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--preview-muted, #6f7771); font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 "Roboto", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-panel-tabs button[aria-pressed="true"] { border-bottom-color: var(--editor-panel-accent, #934c2e); color: var(--editor-panel-accent, #934c2e); } .ds-panel-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--editor-panel-accent, #934c2e); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-panel-tabs button:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Settings Section Navigation
components.description: The selected Settings mode and sidebar section share a distinct violet accent.
components.css: .ds-settings-navigation { display: grid; gap: 4px; font: 400 var(--editor-text-control, 0.875rem)/1.5 "Roboto", sans-serif; } .ds-settings-navigation button { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--preview-ink, #2e3835); font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-settings-navigation button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #eae5d9; } .ds-settings-navigation button[aria-current="page"], .ds-settings-navigation button[aria-current="page"]:hover { background: var(--editor-settings-selected, #e9e1ef); color: var(--editor-settings-ink, #67517c); font-weight: 600; } .ds-settings-navigation button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #985637; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-settings-navigation button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.38; } .ds-settings-navigation button > span { flex: 1; } .ds-settings-navigation svg { flex: none; width: 19px; height: 19px; } .ds-settings-navigation .ds-settings-chevron { width: 14px; height: 14px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-settings-navigation { display: flex; gap: 6px; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: thin; } .ds-settings-navigation button { flex: none; width: auto; min-height: 44px; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-settings-navigation .ds-settings-chevron { display: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Cabane's editor uses warm paper, green-toned ink and quiet surfaces around the home. Roboto keeps tools and object information practical and compact. The home, catalog thumbnails and plan provide the imagery; the controls supply a readable working frame.

Connect extends this existing world with a sage device rail, blue connection selection and a pale source surface. Color and spacing separate working areas while labels explain the state of each object. This document records the implemented editor and its Connect and Properties patterns; it does not establish a new brand identity.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces and dark green-toned text.
Compact English controls with clear object and connection names.
Tonal grouping, restrained borders and soft corners.
Model thumbnails and the existing SVG icon family.
Independent visual treatment for selection, connection availability and model display.

rules.name: The Separate States Rule
rules.body: Selection, source availability and display on the model have separate visual cues. Pair status color with a label or icon.

rules.name: The Stable Context Rule
rules.body: Preserve the selected object and named connection while searching or filtering sources. Keep search and type filters immediately above the flat source list.

dos: **Do** reuse the editor palette, Roboto and the existing model-thumbnail and SVG-icon systems.
**Do** give connection, availability, selection and model display their own labeled cues.
**Do** keep source search and type filters adjacent to the source list.
**Do** align Connect column headings with the shared connection-heading role.
**Do** keep mobile navigation sequential with clear return actions.
**Do** reveal reading configuration after the corresponding action.
donts: **Don't** use status color as the only explanation of a connection's state.
**Don't** expose entity IDs as the default source label.
**Don't** turn every source row into an elevated card.
**Don't** compress all three Connect columns into the mobile viewport.
**Don't** replace the incumbent Cabane typography, palette or icon family when extending these surfaces.
